name: canton-dtc-treasury
title: Canton DTC Tokenized Treasury Issuance & Settlement
description: Validate a DTCC/ComposerX tokenized U.S. Treasury for issuance and atomic settlement. Regulatory/asset classification (510) → DTC-custody link, Fed-eligibility, ComposerX DAML lifecycle and programmable-collateral-at-issuance (art-109) → PFMI P12 atomic DvP (507) → tokenized-collateral eligibility for reuse (505). Treasury/DTC-custody-specific; not generic securities lifecycle, not FICC clearing economics. Live since October 28, 2026 per DTCC's launch announcement: DTC tokenizes Russell 1000 constituents, index-tracking ETFs and U.S. Treasuries under a December 2025 SEC no-action letter; as of November 2026 the service's cash leg settles by wire or ACH over fiat rails while tokenized securities move on the Canton Network and DTCC's private Besu network.

steps.handoff: instrument class and DLT-pilot eligibility feed Stage 2 DTC-treasury validation
custody link, Fed-eligibility, DAML lifecycle gaps feed Stage 3 DvP atomicity
atomic DvP verdict feeds Stage 4 collateral eligibility
Exports composite tokenized-treasury artifact with execution_hash — final stage
